data.text: May the LORD answer you in the day of distress; may the name of the God of Jacob set you safely on high.
data.subtitulo: For the music leader. A psalm of David.

data.text: May he send you help from the sanctuary and support you from Zion.
May he remember all your offerings and accept your burnt offering. Selah.
May he grant you your heart’s desire and fulfill all your plans.
We will shout for joy over your salvation and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD fulfill all your requests.
Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heavens with the saving might of his right hand.
data.titulo: Confidence in the LORD's Saving Power

data.text: Some rely on chariots and some on horses, but we call to mind the name of the LORD our God.
They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stand firm.
LORD, save! May the king answer us on the day we call.
